name: Potion of Animal Friendship

source.note: Entered from knowledge of the 2024 DMG (personal build); check every number against the book.

summary: For 1 hour, cast Animal Friendship (save DC 13) at will.
text: When you drink this potion, you can cast the Animal Friendship spell (save DC 13) at will for 1 hour. Agitating the muddy liquid brings little bits into view: a fish scale, a hummingbird tongue, a cat claw, a squirrel hair.
